g.text: U1 · MCP23017 BREAKOUT · LONG EDGE IN A FEMALE 1×20
⏚ is one net: P9, U1, J2·1 / 12 / 26, U2 GND + ADDR
odd row only · 7 Dupont jumpers · P pin 4 pulled
at the rail entry · C1 stripe to GND
lamp: common anode on J2·11 (+3V3) · GPIO low = lit
I²C 0x20 · A0–A2 → GND on the board
4.7 k SDA/SCL pull-ups on the board
~100 k input pull-ups in the chip
right: the long edge in board order
PA7 … PA0, GND, VCC, PB0 … PB7, GND, VCC
keys are wired to the MCP pin their J2 strip lands on · the descriptor follows
